task_title: Make Floor 1 AI tasks scenario-config driven

plan_review.notes: Adopted the quest-derived graph plus scenario adapter alternative. Quest pack IDs/objectives remain canonical and a validated Floor 1 AI overlay supplies only runtime dependencies/effects, generic operations, eligibility/completion, work estimation, and execution. Rejected a duplicated full-chain config due to drift; rejected registry-local callbacks due to scenarioDefinitions bloat; rejected Floor-1-shaped target kinds in favor of generic move/interact/engage/farm/ambient operations. Revised plan includes explicit negative door effects, deterministic snapshot/revision keys, committed-task reverse mapping, load-time graph validation, and migration of auto-progression consumers.
